MEET THE ARTIST / 유다빈밴드

YdBB

YdBB are a five-piece band built around singer-songwriter Yu Dabin. Their music moves between acoustic folk and rock, with songs about the people and feelings we carry with us.

INDIE ROCK / 2023

ONCE

Official audio

View release on Apple Music ↗

“ONCE” is about letting someone go while hoping they’ll remember you kindly. Yu Dabin describes that farewell in the band’s release interview for the October 2023 single.

A little background

Yu Dabin made the cover herself, drawing over a photograph of her own hand. She left the thing held inside unnamed, so it could mean something different to each listener.

INSIDE THE LYRICS

Hoping to be remembered kindly

  • Farewell
  • Memory

ONCE looks back at the moment affection began while speaking from the edge of a goodbye. The speaker wants a place in the other person’s memory, even as distance grows between them.

That wish gives the farewell its tenderness and its uncertainty: nobody can choose how they will be remembered. Regret remains, alongside a hope that distance need not erase their bond. The song makes room for an attachment that continues as two people grow apart, without promising that affection will bring them back together.
